section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section reviews theoretical frameworks and empirical literature on the relationships between body image, eating psychopathology, and emotion regulation processes. The authors discuss psychological inflexibility, cognitive fusion, and self-compassion as mediators, and emphasize the importance of studying positive body image constructs like body appreciation. The section concludes by stating that 'the current study aims to clarify the distinct effects of body image-related cognitive fusion and body appreciation in the relationship between negative perceptions about one's body image and the enactment of disordered eating behaviours, while controlling the effect of BMI,' indicating at least one empirical study will follow, though specific study details are not provided in this introduction.
